quarterly_data.quarter: Delta Electronics press release: Delta Electronics' Consolidated Sales Revenues for (10-12-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Delta Electronics reported unaudited consolidated sales revenues for September 2026 of NT$65,400 million, a 14.6 percent increase from NT$57,061 million in September 2025 and a 1.3 percent increase from NT$64,586 million in August 2026. Cumulative January-September 2026 consolidated sales revenues were NT$539,668 million, a 37.2 percent increase from NT$393,272 million in the same period of 2025. September 2026 sales mix: Power Electronics 51%, Infrastructure 35%, Automation 8%, Mobility 6%.
quarterly_data.figure: September 2026 NT$65,400 million (+14.6% YoY, +1.3% MoM); Jan-Sep 2026 NT$539,668 million (+37.2% YoY); Power Electronics 51%, Infrastructure 35%, Automation 8%, Mobility 6%
